Some R scripts require results to be generated by the matching Fortran program first.

The original baseline.exe was successfully launched for verified small runs in this project, after locating its Intel OpenMP runtime in an existing MATLAB installation. Compilation and original-code guidance: [`docs/ORIGINAL_CODE.md`](../../docs/ORIGINAL_CODE.md). The independently written Python experiments are separate from these retained sources.
